newsitem.title: FINLAND: MOBILE PHONE PRICES DOWN 13 PCT '98 - FINNISH LOBBY.
newsitem.headline: MOBILE PHONE PRICES DOWN 13 PCT '98 - FINNISH LOBBY.

text.p: The federation of Finnish electronics wholesalers said on Wednesday it expected the average consumer price of mobile phones to fall 13 percent to 2,000 markka next year from this year.

In a table showing average prices from 1988 to next year, the federation said this year's price was 2,300 markka per unit, down from last year's 2,750 markka. In 1988, the average price for mobile phones sold was 12,000 markka.
Finland has the biggest penetration of mobile phones in the world, with more than one handset for every three Finns.
